commands.help: Create or delete scheduled tasks through direct registry manipulation
commands.long_help: Use operation=delete with computer-name and task-name. For operation=add, program, username, and schedule-type are required; second/daily/weekly schedules also require time, and weekly requires days. Use computer-name=localhost for the current system.

arguments.name: computer-name
arguments.desc: Remote computer name, or localhost for the current system

arguments.name: program
arguments.desc: Program to execute when adding a task

arguments.name: username
arguments.desc: Account under which the task runs

arguments.name: schedule-type
arguments.desc: Trigger type: second, daily, weekly, or logon

arguments.name: time
arguments.desc: Seconds for a second trigger, or HH:MM for daily and weekly triggers

arguments.name: days
arguments.desc: Comma-separated weekdays for a weekly trigger
